fidelity: F2a — Psychrometric Heat-Mass Transfer with Lumped Transient ODE
source: ASHRAE Handbook of Fundamentals (2021) ch.1 Psychrometrics; Camargo, Ebinuma & Silveira (2005) 'Experimental performance of a direct evaporative cooler', Int. J. Thermal Sciences 44(3); Stull (2011) wet-bulb approximation, J. Appl. Meteorol. Climatol. 50(11)

unit.name: Generic Direct (Rigid Media Pad) Evaporative Cooler — Physics-Lumped

epsilon_sat_design.note: Design saturation effectiveness of cellulose rigid-media pad (Camargo 2005, 100-300mm pads: 0.7-0.95)

ntu_design.note: Transfer units NTU = -ln(1-eps); eps=0.85 -> NTU=1.897. eps_sat = 1 - exp(-NTU)

P_fan_W.note: Fan electrical power for 1 kg/s air (typical residential cooler)

Cp_air_J_kgK.note: Specific heat dry air at ~300K (ASHRAE Fundamentals)

h_fg_J_kg.note: Latent heat of vaporization of water at ~20C (ASHRAE: 2.45 MJ/kg)

pad_mass_kg.note: Wetted thermal mass of pad + retained water (lumped)

pad_cp_J_kgK.note: Effective specific heat of wetted pad (water-dominated)

NTU_air_pad.note: Air-to-pad transfer units governing transient time constant
